MultiplayRef.title: ⚡ Quick Reference
MultiplayRef.subtitle: Just the essentials, no lengthy explanations.
MultiplayRef.s1Note: That's all you need to start using the ALPMultiplayer class.
MultiplayRef.s2Note: No strict order required. Registering callbacks first is conventional.
MultiplayRef.s2Code:
const mp = new ALPMultiplayer();

mp.on('event', handler);      // Register callbacks first (recommended)
mp.onPlayers(handler);        // Works before or after joinRoom
await mp.joinRoom(...);       // Join room
MultiplayRef.joinRoomDesc: Join a room. Always call last.
MultiplayRef.joinRoomRoom: Same roomId = same room. Match it for everyone.
MultiplayRef.joinRoomInfo: Name, color, etc. Free-form. Others receive it via onPlayers.
MultiplayRef.joinRoomPw: Set/enter a password. Wrong password → Promise rejected.
MultiplayRef.onPlayersDesc: Called when someone joins or leaves. Receives the current player array.
MultiplayRef.onPredictDesc: Recommended for position sync. SDK uses an interpolation buffer to compute smooth 60fps positions and call your callback. No separate lerp code needed.
MultiplayRef.sendDesc: Sends an event to all other players in the room. Not delivered to yourself.
MultiplayRef.updateDesc: Update your info (name, score, etc.). Other players' onPlayers will re-fire.
MultiplayRef.leaveDesc: Leave the room. Automatically removed from others' onPlayers.
MultiplayRef.joinVoiceDesc: Requests mic permission and P2P connects to all room members via WebRTC.
MultiplayRef.leaveVoiceDesc: End voice. Called automatically on leave().
MultiplayRef.onVoiceDesc: Called when voice connection status changes.
MultiplayRef.isHostDesc: Returns whether you are the first player (host). Only the host should run monster AI / collision detection and broadcast results via send().
MultiplayRef.isHostNote: Host leaves → onPlayers() re-fires → re-check isHost()
MultiplayRef.getRoomsDesc: Get the list of open rooms for this game. Call as ALPMultiplayer.getRooms() without an instance.
MultiplayRef.getRoomsReturns: Returns: [{ id, count, hasPassword }] — sorted by count desc. Use hasPassword for 🔒 UI.
MultiplayRef.s5Desc: Adding { predict: true } makes the SDK buffer received positions and call your callback at 60fps with linearly interpolated values from 50ms in the past. No separate interpolation code needed in your game loop.
MultiplayRef.s6Desc: Opening multiple rooms scales the total player count accordingly.
MultiplayRef.mistake0Bad: Awaiting the return value of send()
MultiplayRef.mistake0Fix: send() returns void. No await needed.
MultiplayRef.mistake2Fix: Use lerp to smoothly follow the position
MultiplayRef.mistake3Bad: Assuming own events come back to you
MultiplayRef.mistake3Fix: send() is not delivered to yourself. Handle your own state locally.

MultiplayGuide.heroSubPre: Add real-time multiplayer in 3 steps using the ALP platform's
MultiplayGuide.s1Desc: Games are hosted as static files (HTML/JS) on R2. Each player's browser connects directly to Cloudflare's Durable Objects via WebSocket to exchange real-time data. No separate server needed.
MultiplayGuide.feat1Desc:
Real-time event delivery
(move, attack, chat, etc.)
MultiplayGuide.feat3Desc:
game:{slug}:{roomId}
channel — fully separated per game
MultiplayGuide.step1: Add one SDK line to index.html
MultiplayGuide.step1Note: The SDK is automatically served at /_alp/sdk.js by a Cloudflare Worker. Supabase credentials are injected server-side — no need to write them in your code.
MultiplayGuide.step3: Join a room and send events
MultiplayGuide.joinRoomDesc: Join the specified room and register your info in Presence. Connects to Cloudflare Durable Objects via WebSocket. Resolves after receiving the welcome message from the server.
MultiplayGuide.joinRoomP1: Room name (same slug + roomId → same room)
MultiplayGuide.joinRoomP2: Your info registered in Presence (free-form JSON). Other players receive it via onPlayers().
MultiplayGuide.joinRoomP3: Room password. The first player to enter sets it. Later players who get it wrong will have the Promise rejected.
MultiplayGuide.getRoomsDesc: Get the list of currently open rooms for this game. Can be called as a static method without an instance. Sorted by player count descending.
MultiplayGuide.getRoomsP1: Game slug. If omitted, auto-detected from the current URL.
MultiplayGuide.getRoomsP4: Whether a password is required (use for 🔒 icon in lobby UI)
MultiplayGuide.onDesc: Receive events sent by other players via send(). Can be called before or after joinRoom().
MultiplayGuide.onP2: Function called on receipt. payload is the object passed to send().
MultiplayGuide.onP3: When true, enables interpolation buffer. Calls callback at 60fps with linearly interpolated positions between received packets. Recommended for position sync events.
MultiplayGuide.onP4: Payload field names for id/position when using predict. Defaults: 'id', 'x', 'y'
MultiplayGuide.onPlayersDesc: Called whenever the room's player list changes. Can be called before or after joinRoom().
MultiplayGuide.onPlayersP1: players is an array of each player's playerInfo (disconnected players are automatically removed)
MultiplayGuide.sendDesc: Sends an event to all other players in the room. Not delivered to yourself.
MultiplayGuide.updatePlayerDesc: Updates your info registered in Presence. Other players' onPlayers() callbacks will be re-invoked.
MultiplayGuide.leaveDesc: Leave the room. Automatically removed from other players' onPlayers(). Handled automatically on page unload.
MultiplayGuide.isHostDesc: Returns whether the current client is the room host (the first player to join). Only the host should control game objects (monster AI, collision detection, etc.) and broadcast results. Re-check when onPlayers() is called after a host leaves.
MultiplayGuide.isHostP1: The playerInfo passed to joinRoom() must have an id field for isHost() to work.
MultiplayGuide.s4Sub: Minimal example where players can see each other's positions in real time
MultiplayGuide.s5Sub: How to sync non-player objects like monsters, projectiles, and traps
MultiplayGuide.warnDesc: If all clients independently run monster AI, positions will diverge. Only one client (the host) should control objects; the rest receive and render.
MultiplayGuide.s5Desc: mp.isHost() returns whether you are the first player to join the room (the host). When the host leaves, onPlayers() is re-invoked — re-check at that point.
MultiplayGuide.s6Sub: Fetch the list of open rooms to build a lobby screen
MultiplayGuide.s6Desc: Call ALPMultiplayer.getRooms() to get the list of currently open rooms and their player counts. It's a static method — no instance needed.
MultiplayGuide.s6LobbyDesc: Below is a minimal lobby implementation. It auto-refreshes every 5 seconds and shows 🔒 for password-protected rooms.
MultiplayGuide.s6Tip0: The password is set by the first player to enter. Later players must use the same password.
MultiplayGuide.s6Tip1: getRooms() only returns hasPassword: true/false, not the password itself.
MultiplayGuide.s6Tip2: Empty rooms are auto-removed (within ~2 minutes of count reaching 0).
MultiplayGuide.s7Desc: The numbers below are recommended per room. Creating multiple rooms scales the total player count accordingly.
MultiplayGuide.tip0: Call send() immediately on key press and again every 16ms. Good for frequently changing values like position.
MultiplayGuide.tip1: For smooth remote player movement, use { predict: true } in on(). The SDK handles interpolation automatically.
MultiplayGuide.tip2: To join the same room, use the same roomId. Different roomIds mean different rooms.
MultiplayGuide.s8Sub: WebRTC P2P voice between players in the same room — no server relay, free
MultiplayGuide.s8Desc: Calling mp.joinVoice() requests microphone permission and connects directly to all players in the room via WebRTC. Audio data never passes through a server, so there's no extra cost.
MultiplayGuide.voice0Desc: Request mic permission and P2P connect to all room members
MultiplayGuide.voice2Desc: Update UI on joined / left events
MultiplayGuide.voiceTip0: Audio is sent P2P directly — no Cloudflare Worker/DO relay, so it's free.
MultiplayGuide.voiceTip1: Strict NAT environments (corporate/school networks) may need a TURN server. Pass it via joinVoice({ iceServers: [...] }).
MultiplayGuide.voiceTip2: Mesh topology (everyone connects to everyone) — recommended 10 players or fewer.
MultiplayGuide.voiceTip3: Calling mp.leave() automatically ends voice as well.
MultiplayGuide.faq0Q: Does onPlayers() need to be called before joinRoom()?
MultiplayGuide.faq0A: No. It can be called at any point before or after joinRoom(). If you register it after already joining, you'll immediately receive the current player list.
MultiplayGuide.faq1Q: Are rooms created and deleted automatically?
MultiplayGuide.faq1A: Yes. Calling joinRoom() creates the channel, and when all players leave() or navigate away, the channel is automatically destroyed. No separate DB storage needed.
MultiplayGuide.faq2Q: Do I receive my own sent events?
MultiplayGuide.faq2A: No. Events sent via send() are not delivered to yourself. Manage your own state locally.
MultiplayGuide.faq3A: Yes. Pass { password: 'yourpassword' } as the third argument to joinRoom(). The first player sets the password; later players who enter the wrong one will have the Promise rejected. Use getRooms()'s hasPassword field to show 🔒 in the lobby.
MultiplayGuide.faq4Q: How do I persist game state (DB storage)?
MultiplayGuide.faq4A: Use ALPMultiplayer for real-time multiplayer, and the platform's game_state API for persistent game data. Save with PUT /api/game-state/{slug} and load with GET.
